description: Test data for insert/update/upsert, preview, # row copy, and column sequence behavior

rows.targetSql: INSERT INTO TGT_USERS (USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, DISPLAY_NAME, EMAIL) VALUES (:USER_ID, :LOGIN_ID, :DISPLAY_NAME, :EMAIL)
UPDATE TGT_USERS SET LOGIN_ID = :LOGIN_ID, DISPLAY_NAME = :DISPLAY_NAME, EMAIL = :EMAIL WHERE USER_ID = :USER_ID

MERGE INTO TGT_USERS t USING (SELECT :USER_ID USER_ID, :LOGIN_ID LOGIN_ID, :DISPLAY_NAME DISPLAY_NAME, :EMAIL EMAIL FROM dual) s ON (t.USER_ID = s.USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.LOGIN_ID = s.LOGIN_ID, t.DISPLAY_NAME = s.DISPLAY_NAME, t.EMAIL = s.EMAIL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, DISPLAY_NAME, EMAIL) VALUES (s.USER_ID, s.LOGIN_ID, s.DISPLAY_NAME, s.EMAIL)
